senses.sense_definition: A projecting canopy over an entrance to a theater or hotel, often bearing a signboard displaying names, titles, or announcements.

examples.text: The theater's <w>marquee</w> displayed the titles of all the films showing tonight.
Fans gathered under the bright <w>marquee</w> outside the concert hall.

senses.sense_definition: A large tent used for outdoor entertainment, parties, or special events.

examples.text: They decided to hire a large <w>marquee</w> for the outdoor wedding reception.
Guests took shelter inside the white <w>marquee</w> when it started raining.

senses.sense_definition: In graphical editing software, an interactive selection tool or outline used to highlight a specific portion of an image.

examples.text: Use the rectangular <w>marquee</w> to select the part of the image you want to crop.
After creating a circular <w>marquee</w>, she adjusted the color balance of that area.

senses.sense_definition: A banner or element on a web page displaying text that scrolls automatically.

examples.text: The old website featured an annoying <w>marquee</w> scrolling across the top of the page.
Breaking news flashed across the screen in an animated text <w>marquee</w>.

senses.sense_definition: An illuminated panel mounted above the screen of an arcade cabinet, displaying the game's title and artwork.

examples.text: He replaced the damaged <w>marquee</w> on the vintage arcade machine with an original one.
The bright backlight made the colorful <w>marquee</w> of the cabinet glow across the room.

senses.sense_definition: A row of decorative lights that flash or turn on and off in rapid sequence.

examples.text: The flashing <w>marquee</w> drew visitors toward the entrance of the amusement park.
Bright bulbs of the <w>marquee</w> flickered rhythmically throughout the carnival night.

senses.sense_definition: Most famous, prominent, or important; preeminent.

examples.text: Signing the <w>marquee</w> player immediately improved ticket sales for the team.
The film festival will conclude tonight with its most anticipated <w>marquee</w> event.

senses.sense_definition: To select an object or image region using a digital marquee selection tool.

examples.text: Simply <w>marquee</w> the background area and press delete to remove it cleanly.
She <w>marqueed</w> the subject's face before applying the sharpening filter.

senses.sense_definition: To display text prominently at the top of a screen or video.

examples.text: The editor decided to <w>marquee</w> the speaker's name during the video opening.
Important safety warnings were <w>marqueed</w> across the top of the live broadcast.
